title: Storm Brewing on the Mountain
next_chapter_hook: Just as he was about to sink into the realm of dreams, a mysterious consciousness beyond mortal perception swept across the Tianqing Sect like a strand of spider silk. That gaze was ice-cold and merciless, resembling the Heavenly Dao's will in the primordial chaos, as it examined its chess pieces...

text.content: The Turtle Shell's temperature continued to rise, and Chen Ji felt something awakening within him—was this the契机 for breaking through, or an even greater crisis? He abruptly opened his eyes, fine beads of sweat on his forehead glittering like stars in the morning light. The cracks on the Turtle Shell's surface seemed to have deepened once more, faintly revealing a ghostly blue glow that resonated with the qi in his dantian. "It's early again..." he murmured, his voice hoarse as if drifting from ancient times. The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace pulsed with warmth, as if urging something.

dialogue.content: The voice of the residual soul echoed in his mind, carrying an unusual gravity: "Boy, your body has already begun accepting the second layer of the Tianji Record's seal. But before that—" Mo Xiansheng paused, "Today's Sect Tournament matter is likely far more troublesome than you imagine."

text.content: When Chen Ji stepped out of the Servants' Quarters, the morning mist had yet to disperse. In the distant Martial Arena, many disciples had already gathered, their whispers carrying words like 'trash,' 'dark horse,' and 'unbelievable.' His expression remained unchanged, his steps steady, as if those discussions had nothing to do with him. Only the fingers hidden within his sleeves curled slightly, betraying the turmoil within—yesterday's battle, he had not won easily, nor cleanly.

dialogue.content: Just then, a majestic voice rang out from the high platform: "Chen Ji, step forward." It was Elder Ling Yuan, the Fifth Elder. That stern face betrayed no hint of emotion. The surrounding murmurs ceased instantly, every gaze fixing upon Chen Ji. Ling Yuan's gaze was profound as an abyss, as if wanting to see through Chen Ji's entire being: "Your performance yesterday was quite unexpected to this seat."

text.content: Chen Ji walked forward with head bowed, his posture respectfully flawless: "Disciple was merely lucky, grateful for the elder brothers' leniency." His voice carried just the right amount of fear, his shoulders trembling slightly, like a fawn being watched by a tiger. The curve of Ling Yuan's lips carried a meaningful arc, yet that smile sent a chill down Chen Ji's back—just what was this old fox smiling about?

dialogue.content: "Luck?" Ling Yuan repeated these two words, his tone playful, "This seat has lived for several hundred years, yet this is the first time I've seen someone at the Qi Refining Third Stage receive a Foundation Building disciple's full-power strike. The secrets you carry are far more numerous than this seat imagined." He extended his hand, his withered fingers pointing vaguely toward Chen Ji's brow center, "Would you allow this seat to examine your bone constitution?"

text.content: Though those fingertips had yet to touch him, the air around Chen Ji had already frozen. He felt the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace violently trembling, as if issuing some warning. Examine his bone constitution? If this examination proceeded, the Tianji Record's existence would certainly be exposed. Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, his mind racing through countermeasures, yet his face remained that mask of terror: "Disciple... how dare disciple trouble the Elder..."

dialogue.content: "Fifth Elder." A clear and cold voice suddenly rang out. Su Qingyao had somehow appeared nearby, her expression cold yet carrying undeniable authority, "Sect Rule Number Seven: When Elders examine a disciple's bone constitution, it must be approved by the Stewardship Hall and three Elders must be present. Are you intending to violate the rules?" Her gaze locked with Ling Yuan's, and sparks seemed to fly in the air between them.

Ling Yuan withdrew his hand, his smile not diminishing but growing: "Su Junior Niece has an excellent memory. Very well, since the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow has spoken, this seat shall not make things difficult for this lad today." Before turning to leave, his voice dropped extremely low, audible only to Chen Ji: "However—some things can be hidden for a time, but not forever." Those words were like a serpent's forked tongue, causing Chen Ji's heart to sink into the depths.

text.content: Only after Ling Yuan had gone far did Chen Ji slightly relax, yet he found Su Qingyao looking at him with a knowing smile. That gaze was sharp as a blade, seemingly dissecting every layer of his disguise. "Senior Sister Su..." he began to offer thanks, but she raised her hand to interrupt. "No need to thank me." Su Qingyao's voice was soft, yet each word was crystal clear, "I simply wish to know what secrets you carry."

Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat, yet a bitter smile spread across his face: "Senior Sister jests, what secrets could I possibly have? Just a piece of trash, that's all." His tone was so sincere it seemed like he were stating a fundamental truth of the Heavenly Dao, yet Su Qingyao's eyes told him—she did not believe. From their first meeting, this woman had never truly believed in his trash persona.

dialogue.content: "You needn't pretend before me." Su Qingyao stepped forward, lowering her voice, "Yesterday when I was on duty at the Scripture Repository, I overheard someone discussing—" her gaze tightly locked onto Chen Ji's eyes, "They were speaking of 'the Chen Family' and 'Heavenly Secrets.' Chen Ji, your origins are likely far less simple than you've claimed."

text.content: Chen Family. Heavenly Secrets. These two phrases exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder. His pupils contracted sharply, his breath stopping in an instant, the hands hidden in his sleeves clenching into fists. In his mind surfaced that blurry figure—his sister Chen Nian's heartbreaking screams as she was taken away, and the worn book his mother had pressed into his hands on her deathbed.

"Where are those people?" Chen Ji's voice abruptly became low and hoarse, beneath that calm exterior churned hidden currents. He raised his head, revealing undisguised sharpness for the first time before Su Qingyao—a gaze that made even Su Qingyao startle slightly. This was clearly notrash disciple at all, but a sheathed sword poised to strike!

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, as if reevaluating the person before her. "The West Courtyard guest rooms house a few outsiders, claiming to be side-branch disciples of some minor family. But from their movements—" she paused, "They possess at least the level of Xuanwu Sect Outer Disciples or higher. They arrived yesterday afternoon, precisely one hour after your tournament ended."

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned ice-cold. They move quickly indeed... he thought coldly. Yesterday's martial display was merely a probe, testing how much strength this 'trash' truly possessed. And those people's reactions confirmed his suspicions—they had indeed come for 'the Chen Family' and 'Heavenly Secrets.' Xuanwu Sect members? Or could it be... the Holy Sect?

Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the turmoil within, and donned his mask of simple honesty once more. He bowed deeply to Su Qingyao: "Many thanks to Senior Sister for the information. This matter... allow me to consider." Su Qingyao said nothing, merely watching him quietly, her gaze carrying a more complex meaning—beyond the scrutiny, there seemed to be an ounce of worry she herself had yet to notice.

choice.prompt: Night fell. Chen Ji stood alone outside the Servants' Quarters, gazing toward the flickering lights of the West Courtyard. The intelligence was in hand—how should he proceed?

choices.text: Take the initiative and infiltrate the West Courtyard under cover of night
choices.description: Strike while they are still unsettled and investigate the truth personally. If one could capture one of them, perhaps the identity of the mastermind could be extracted.
choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative and obtain crucial intelligence
choices.risk_hint: The enemy numbers at least three, and may have traps set in advance

text.content: Chen Ji changed into a set of night clothes, his figure gliding through the darkness like a ghost. However, just as he approached the West Courtyard, a strange Spiritual Energy fluctuation made him stop abruptly—someone had set up detection formations around the area.

He took out a talisman from his bosom with a cold smile—this was the concealment talisman given to him by Mo Xiansheng, capable of briefly shrouding his presence. The talisman turned into a thin mist that enveloped him, and he stepped unhesitantly into the forbidden zone, rushing toward a guest room with its lights still on.

choices.description: Since the opponent has shown themselves proactively, they must have ulterior motives. Better to use stillness to overcome movement, and see where they place their next chess piece.
choices.visible_reward: Strike only after seeing the full picture, reducing risk
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent takes the initiative to attack, we might fall into a passive situation

text.content: Chen Ji turned back toward the Servants' Quarters, but encountered Su Qingyao midway. She leaned against a corridor pillar, the moonlight outlining her cold features, a Jade Slip clutched in her hand. "I knew you'd come back." Her voice carried a hint of teasing.

Chen Ji stopped with a bitter smile: "Senior sister seems to know my whereabouts intimately." Su Qingyao tossed the Jade Slip to him: "This is my compiled information on those people, containing their Spiritual Energy characteristics and daily habits. It might be useful to you."

choices.text: Confuse truth with falsehood, spread rumors
choices.description: Exploit his "waste" image, spread false information about the Tianji Record, lure the snake out of its hole, and make enemies lose their composure.
choices.visible_reward: Turn public opinion, gain control of the narrative initiative
choices.risk_hint: Requires meticulous planning, consequences could be severe if it fails

text.content: Chen Ji found Li San, a fellow servant disciple he was close to, whose greatest virtues were being gossipy and fond of wine. Chen Ji treated him to a drink and "accidentally" revealed that during a herb-gathering trip, he had picked up a strange ancient book that seemed to record some secret about "Heavenly Secrets."

Li San indeed lived up to expectations. The next day, the whole Tianqing Sect was spreading the news: the waste Chen Ji had once picked up a celestial book! The news spread like wildfire, quickly reaching the ears of those "minor family disciples" in the West Courtyard. That night, Chen Ji noticed the lights in the West Courtyard stayed on all night.

Meanwhile, in the study of Fifth Elder Ling Yuan, a secret letter was being burned by candlelight. Ling Yuan watched the letter turn to ashes, a cold, sinister smile appearing on his aged face: "As I expected... The inheritor of the Tianji Record is hidden right under our noses." He asked toward the shadows, "Are the people over there ready?"

dialogue.content: A hoarse voice came from the shadows: "Reporting to the Elder, people from the Holy Sect have already secretly infiltrated the Tianqing Sect. As long as you give the order, we can act at any time." Ling Yuan shook his head: "Not yet. Let him be arrogant for a few more days. I want to see what waves this waste of a disciple can make—and that Su Qingyao should also be given a warning."

text.content: Chen Ji stood atop the Servants' Quarters, gazing at the pale crescent moon in the night sky. In his hand was a communication jade talisman—a life-saving item left to him by Ye Qing. "Demonic Path Holy Sect..." he murmured to himself, a cold light flickering in his eyes, "It seems my sister who disappeared many years ago is probably connected to the Holy Sect."

The Turtle Shell in his embrace grew warm again, as if the Tianji Record Fragment sensed something and opened a page on its own. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded: "Boy, you used the foresight ability of the Tianji Record once today, though only for a brief moment, but—" He paused, his tone becoming grave, "Someone is watching you."

dialogue.content: "Watching?" Chen Ji's heart tightened. Mo Xiansheng's voice became ethereal: "That sensation... very ancient, very vast, as if coming from the primordial chaos. I've only felt it once when the Tianji Record was complete. That was—" His voice cut off abruptly, as if touching upon some forbidden topic, "In short, be careful. You're still too weak."

text.content: Just then, an inexplicable chill shot up from his tailbone to the top of his head. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—he felt it! In that pitch-black night sky, something was watching him. That gaze was ice-cold and ruthless, vast as an abyss, as if it had existed since time immemorial, examining a chess piece on its board.

choice.prompt: That mysterious consciousness continued its gaze, and Chen Ji felt his secrets being peeled away layer by layer. Crisis was imminent, he had to make a decision!

choices.description: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate to foresee the movements of that consciousness over the next three hours. The Tianji Record was his only trump card.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial foresight, perceive the source of danger
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is already below 60 points, recovery will be slower after consumption

text.content: The Turtle Shell violently trembled, and Chen Ji felt as if his soul was being ripped from his body. The sound of pages turning from the Tianji Record thundered in his mind, and a blurry image gradually emerged—that pair of eyes belonged to no one, but to... Heaven itself!

The image flashed past, and Chen Ji woke with a start, cold sweat beading on his forehead. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded: 'Did you see it? That thing... it has been watching you. From the day you obtained the Tianji Record, you entered its sight.'

choices.text: Seek help from Ye Qing, conceal the aura
choices.description: Use the communication Jade Slip to contact Ye Qing, asking her to use the Demonic Path Mist to conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, temporarily escaping that gaze.
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily escape the gaze, gain a moment to breathe
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may not arrive in time, and it would expose the connection to the Demonic Path

text.content: The moment the Jade Slip shattered, a shadowy spiritual energy rushed from the distance. Ye Qing's figure appeared indistinctly under the moonlight, clutching a pitch-black pearl in her hand—the core of the Demonic Path Mist. 'Didn't expect to use it so soon.' Her voice was cold, yet carried a hint of concern.

Black mist spilled from the pearl, enveloping Chen Ji entirely. The gaze from the void lingered at the edge of the mist for a moment, then slowly receded. Ye Qing breathed a sigh of relief: 'Temporarily safe. But—' she looked at Chen Ji, 'to attract something like this, the secrets you carry are likely far greater than I imagined.'

choices.description: Deliberately leak more of the Tianji Record's aura, drawing that consciousness to lock onto oneself, while secretly orchestrating a situation where the Fifth Elder and the Holy Sect members exhaust each other.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, potentially leading to complete destruction
choices.visible_reward: Kill two birds with one stone, use others as weapons
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, become the target of all

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, forcibly mobilizing the spiritual energy in his dantian, deliberately allowing the Tianji Record's aura to spread outward. The gaze instantly turned razor-sharp, like a sword drawn from its sheath, piercing directly into the depths of his consciousness.

At the same time, in the west courtyard guest rooms, three Xuanwu Sect 'outer disciples' opened their eyes simultaneously. The leader's face filled with wild joy: 'Found it! The aura of the Tianji Record!' They rushed out of the room without hesitation, heading toward the Servants' Quarters—unaware that in the shadows, the Fifth Elder's men were already poised to strike.

Night deepened, and the Tianqing Sect lay under an eerie stillness. Yet beneath this tranquility, undercurrents surged—candlelight flickered in Ling Yuan's secret chamber; in the west courtyard guest rooms, three outsiders plotted their next move; and in a more distant place, a pair of invisible eyes pierced through layers of void, quietly watching the chess piece named 'Chen Ji'.

Just as Chen Ji believed he had escaped, urgent footsteps sounded outside the Servants' Quarters. Su Qingyao's voice cut through the door, strained with anxiety: 'Chen Ji, come out quickly! Something terrible has happened!' Chen Ji pushed open the door to find Su Qingyao's face deathly pale, clutching a blood-stained Jade Slip in her hand—the token for inner sect emergency communication.

dialogue.content: 'Zhang Shen is dead.' Su Qingyao's voice was soft, yet struck like a heavy hammer. 'Just half an hour ago, he was discovered dead in the Bamboo Grove of the Back Mountain. The state of his body—' she paused, a flicker of disgust crossing her eyes, 'his chest had been ripped open, his heart missing. And beside his corpse, someone had written two characters in blood: 'Heavenly Secrets'.'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Zhang Shen... that outer disciple who had insulted him during the Sect Tournament was actually dead? And he was someone ranked lower on Chen Ji's list of targets—someone had acted first! Who? The Fifth Elder? Those outsiders? Or could it be... someone from the Holy Sect?

Su Qingyao observed Chen Ji's shifting expression and suddenly spoke: 'I came here to tell you something.' Her voice dropped lower. 'An hour before Zhang Shen's death, I saw him meeting with someone from the Fifth Elder's secret chamber. Shortly after that subordinate left, Zhang Shen went to the Back Mountain—and never returned.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent. Everything was moving too fast—the Sect Tournament, the Fifth Elder's test, the outsiders' appearance, Su Qingyao's warning, Zhang Shen's death... all the threads of evidence woven together into a massive web. And he stood at the center of that web, with enemies closing in from every direction.

choice.prompt: The situation grows ever more complex. Chen Ji must re-examine the current circumstances. What does Zhang Shen's death signify?

choices.text: Investigating the truth behind Zhang Shen's death
choices.description: Though Zhang Shen was detestable, his death may conceal crucial clues. Investigating in secret might expose the Fifth Elder's weakness.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Fifth Elder's compromising information to gain the upper hand
choices.risk_hint: The investigation process may encounter danger

text.content: Chen Ji crept into the Rear Mountain Bamboo Grove under the cover of night. The air hung heavy with a pungent scent of blood. He crouched down, carefully examining Zhang Shen's corpse beneath the moonlight—the wound at his chest had clean, precise edges, nothing like what an ordinary cultivator could inflict. This technique, he had seen before in Mo Xiansheng's memories.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: 'This is the Holy Sect's 'Heart Extraction Technique'—specifically used to harvest the hearts of cultivators with special bloodlines. Zhang Shen... he possesses something they need.' Chen Ji abruptly lifted his head, a terrifying thought surfacing—what connection exists between Zhang Shen and the Chen Family?

choices.text: Turn the enemy's scheme against them, set up a counter-strategy
choices.description: Since someone wishes to frame others using Zhang Shen's death, let's turn this scheme to our advantage and force the true mastermind into the open.
choices.visible_reward: Kill two birds with one stone, strike multiple enemies simultaneously
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, one will fall into a desperate situation

text.content: Chen Ji contacted Ye Qing through the night, and the two held a secret discussion in a remote mountain valley. Chen Ji laid out his entire plan: exploit Zhang Shen's death, create false appearances, and sow mutual suspicion between the Fifth Elder and the Holy Sect.

After listening, a flicker of admiration flashed in Ye Qing's eyes: 'Your mind is more complex than anyone I've ever met.' She paused, 'However, with the Holy Sect involved in this matter... I can help you gather some internal intelligence. Consider it—' she gave Chen Ji a meaningful glance, 'an investment.'

choices.text: Temporarily endure, wait for the right moment
choices.description: Zhang Shen's death is too suspicious. Acting rashly would only place oneself in a passive position. Better to remain unmoved and wait for the optimal opportunity.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve oneself, avoid disturbing the enemy
choices.risk_hint: The enemy will not give him much time

text.content: Chen Ji chose to temporarily endure, casting aside all distractions to focus on cultivation. The dormant power within the Turtle Shell was slowly awakening, and he could sense his cultivation advancing steadily. The breakthrough to the fourth stage of Qi Refining was not far away.

At the same time, Su Qingyao began actively gathering intelligence for him. By chance, she discovered that the Fifth Elder had secretly received a messenger from the Holy Sect—and that messenger's visit coincided precisely with the day before Zhang Shen's death. This clue gradually clarified the entire case's context.

The first rays of dawn pierced through the clouds. Chen Ji stood outside the Servants' Quarters, gazing at the undulating rooflines of the Tianqing Sect. His eyes reflected the brightening sky, yet his heart remained shrouded in darkness. Zhang Shen was dead, the Fifth Elder was restless, Holy Sect members had infiltrated, and that gaze of heavenly will still pressed upon him like a blade at his back.

'The storm approaches before the wind.' Chen Ji murmured to himself, a bitter smile curling his lips. He had only wanted to quietly live as atrash, secretly accumulating strength to find his missing sister. Yet the tree may want stillness while the wind does not stop—the appearance of the Tianji Record has completely altered his destiny's trajectory.

The Turtle Shell in his embrace grew warm once more, as if to remind him—the seal on the Tianji Record is gradually lifting, and the power within him slowly awakening. However, every awakening of power brings greater danger drawing near. Mo Xiansheng was right—he remains too weak. Yet time waits for no one; those enemies will not grant him the leisure to develop slowly.

Just then, footsteps approached from afar. Chen Ji looked up to see Su Qingyao walking down the stone steps, the morning light casting a gentle halo over her cold features. In her hands, she held a scroll of bamboo slips. Her expression had calmed considerably compared to last night, yet it carried an ineffable complexity.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, there's something I need to tell you." Su Qingyao stopped before him and handed him the bamboo slip. "The Sect Master emerged from seclusion last night. He noticed your performance in the tournament, as well as Zhang Shen's death." Her voice dropped to a whisper. "The Sect Master has ordered the Elder's Council to convene in three days, and they will investigate the matter thoroughly. And you—" she met Chen Ji's eyes, "—must attend."

text.content: The Elder's Council in three days... Chen Ji took the bamboo slip, his mind racing with calculations. This was danger, yet also opportunity. The Sect Master's personal attention meant Zhang Shen's death had shaken the sect's highest echelons. No matter how bold the Fifth Elder, he would never dare act so blatantly before the Sect Master. And Chen Ji could use this moment to expose the connection between the Fifth Elder and the Holy Sect!

dialogue.content: "Thank you for telling me, Senior Sister." Chen Ji sincerely cupped his hands toward Su Qingyao. This time, he did not disguise himself. Su Qingyao looked at him, a flicker crossing her gaze, but she said nothing more. Before turning to leave, she suddenly paused. "Chen Ji, I don't know what secrets you carry, but I can sense—you are different from us." Her silhouette gradually vanished in the morning light, yet her voice lingered in his ears: "Whatever happens, be careful."

text.content: Chen Ji stood rooted to the spot, watching Su Qingyao's retreating figure, motionless for a long while. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind, carrying a note of sentiment: "This girl, she sees more clearly than others." Chen Ji offered no reply. He simply turned his gaze toward the distant horizon—storm clouds were rolling in from the north, and the scent of an approaching tempest already permeated the air above the entire Tianqing Sect.

Just then, an invisible consciousness swept across the Tianqing Sect once more, this time clearer and sharper than last night. That consciousness seemed capable of piercing through all obstacles, reaching directly into the depths of Chen Ji's soul. He felt every thought, every movement, exposed under the gaze of those formless eyes with nowhere to hide. This was—the Eye of Heavenly Dao!

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the fear and shock within him. His fists tightened, a resolute glint flashing in his eyes. Since Heaven intended to use him as a chess piece, then he would become the most rebellious piece on the board. He would see what happened when this piece began to reverse-control the chessboard—would the high-and-mighty Heavenly Dao still be able to sit calmly on its fishing platform?
